test_cases.title: Guest checkout happy path with valid cart items
test_cases.preconditions: User has items in the cart at http://localhost:3000/cart and is not signed in.
steps: Fill in required shipping and billing details with valid guest information
test_cases.expected_result: Order is placed successfully and redirected to order confirmation page with a thank-you message.

test_cases.title: Checkout form validation blocks submission when required fields are missing
test_cases.preconditions: User has items in the cart and navigates to http://localhost:3000/checkout
steps: Leave required shipping fields (e.g. Full Name or Address) blank
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked and visual validation error messages appear for the missing required fields.

test_cases.title: Promo code edge case validation for expired or invalid codes
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the checkout page http://localhost:3000/checkout with active cart items.
steps: Enter an expired or invalid promo code (e.g., EXPIRED20) into the promo code field
test_cases.expected_result: Application displays a graceful user-friendly rejection message stating the promo code is invalid or expired, without crashing.
